Thanks for the report.

This looks like it may be the same problem as `electron/electron#53350`. If it is, adding your details there helps more than a separate issue. If it is different, a short note on what differs helps a maintainer decide.

To look into this, a maintainer needs a way to reproduce it. Could you make a minimal example in [Electron Fiddle](https://www.electronjs.org/fiddle), save it as a gist and add the link here?

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>

triage: kinds=similar,need-repro refs=#53350
interpretation: Scorer fields represent proposed actions, not GitHub writes.
explanation: The app.commandLine feature switch fails to enable overlay scrollbars despite being set before readiness. Only API fragments are supplied, without a runnable window and scrollable page. Earlier issue 53350 describes the same OverlayScrollbar switch failure with classic scrollbars beginning in version 44; other candidates concern different features and no upstream cause is established.
